title: P&G to Webcast Presentation From P&G Investor Day 2026, November 19
summary: P&G to Webcast Presentation From P&G Investor Day 2026, November 19
body_markdown:
CINCINNATI--(BUSINESS WIRE)--The Procter & Gamble Company (NYSE:PG) will webcast the presentation from the P&G Investor Day 2026 in Cincinnati, Ohio on Thursday, November 19, 2026, beginning at 2:00 p.m. ET (Eastern Time). Chairman of the Board, President and Chief Executive Officer, Shailesh Jejurikar; Chief Financial Officer, Andre Schulten; and the broader executive leadership team will discuss P&G’s strategy and the long-term transformation underway to deliver balanced growth and value creation.


Media and investors may access the live audio webcast at[www.pginvestor.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.pginvestor.com&esheet=54633610&newsitemid=20261105730042&lan=en-US&anchor=www.pginvestor.com&index=1&md5=fbcd7b120971a6b713e60c41a5a26423) . The webcast will also be available for replay.


**About Procter & Gamble**


P&G serves consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ambi Pur®, Ariel®, Bounty®, Charmin®, Crest®, Dawn®, Downy®, Fairy®, Febreze®, Gain®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Lenor®, Olay®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, SK-II®, Tide®, Vicks®, and Whisper®. The P&G community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.
